featureName: MCP action in the real app
location: Inner Quest app → Connect → My Action Items
headline: Connect securely, create an action, see it in Inner Quest
overview: This is the product-facing half of the Inner Quest MCP story. The app explains its secure Codex connection, an authenticated MCP call creates a fictional action, and the exact result appears in My Action Items with its details intact.
targetAudience: People deciding whether Inner Quest MCP reaches the actual Personal OS

steps.title: Connection is a product flow, not a copied secret
steps.action: Opened Inner Quest Connect and expanded the developer setup.
steps.description: The recommended flow is install, connect, and approve: Codex handles the secure sign-in and can refresh or disconnect access. The advanced section keeps public endpoints available for other clients without making raw keys the default experience.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest Connect screen showing the secure Codex connection and advanced developer setup

steps.title: The MCP action lands in My Action Items
steps.action: Created a high-priority fictional action through the authenticated Inner Quest MCP connector, then filtered the real app to that title.
steps.description: The exact result appears in the Backlog lane of My Action Items. The filter isolates the fictional proof record so no unrelated private action titles are published in the walkthrough.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest My Action Items showing the exact fictional action created through MCP

steps.title: The action arrives with usable product detail
steps.action: Opened the MCP-created action in the normal Inner Quest editor.
steps.description: The title, To Do status, High priority, and fictional provenance note are all present in the app. This is the same editable record a person would work with, not a protocol response rendered as a fake screen.
steps.screenshotAlt: Inner Quest action detail showing the MCP-created title, status, priority, and fictional note
steps.location: Inner Quest → My Action Items → Action detail

keyFeatures: The exact result visible in My Action Items
Private background records excluded from captures
tips: The proof action is explicitly fictional and was removed from the private account after capture.
note: Live-walked in the authenticated owner app with a single fictional action. Captures were isolated to that record and contain no unrelated private action titles.
